description: For Illinois landlords and property owners: drafts the right Illinois Supreme Court statewide eviction notice (5-Day for unpaid rent, 10-Day for a lease violation, 30-Day non-renewal or termination, or Demand for Immediate Possession for a squatter) from the facts, computes the notice period, the serve-by date and the earliest filing date with court holidays, checks it against Chicago RLTO, Cook County RTLO, state statute and fair housing limits, and quotes this firm's flat fee, filing fee and service costs for the courthouse. Returns a DRAFT for attorney review; it sends nothing. Use when a landlord asks how to evict a tenant in Illinois, which notice to serve, or what an Illinois eviction costs. The firm does not represent tenants.

amount_includes_other_charges.description: Anything besides rent the landlord wants on the 5-Day (late_fees, utilities, attorney_fees, damages). Leave empty if rent only

county.description: County, required outside Cook (e.g. DuPage, Kane, Lake, Will)

ever_had_permission.description: Squatter only: the person ever had permission to live there

ever_paid_rent.description: Squatter only: the person ever paid rent

jackson_park_area.description: Chicago property inside the Jackson Park notice pilot area

lease_paragraph.description: 10-Day only: the lease paragraph broken, e.g. Paragraph 12

municipality.description: City or village of the property, e.g. Chicago, Skokie, Naperville

owner_occupied_6_or_fewer.description: Owner lives in the building and it has 6 or fewer units (changes Chicago and Cook rules)

property_vacant.description: No one is in actual possession (needed for posting)

property_zip.description: City, state and ZIP line, e.g. Chicago, IL 60614

rent_due_date.description: 5-Day only: the date the unpaid rent was due, YYYY-MM-DD

rent_owed.description: 5-Day only: rent owed, rent only (no late fees, utilities, attorney fees)

requester_role.description: Who is asking. The firm represents owners only

service_date.description: Planned service date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default tomorrow

service_method.description: How it will be served. Default personal

tenancy_start_date.description: 30-Day only: when the tenant first moved in, YYYY-MM-DD (Chicago periods depend on it)

tenant_complained_last_12_months.description: Tenant complained to the landlord or a government agency, or asked for repairs, in the last 12 months

tenant_names.description: Every adult tenant's full name. Unknown occupants are added automatically

termination_date.description: 30-Day only: the date the tenancy ends, YYYY-MM-DD

violation_description.description: 10-Day only: the conduct, specific (what, where, who)

name: prepare_eviction_notice
title: Draft an Illinois eviction notice
